resource.title: Fundamentals of Wireless Communication（David Tse & Pramod Viswanath, Cambridge University Press 2005；作者主页提供在线版全书 PDF）
resource.access: 斯坦福作者主页（David Tse）提供全书各章 PDF 免费在线阅读；纸质书需向 Cambridge University Press 购买。各章可单独下载，含习题
resource.covers: 按作者主页章节清单：'The wireless channel'（路径损耗、阴影、多径衰落）、'Point-to-point communication: detection, diversity and channel uncertainty'（分集、检测）、'Cellular systems: multiple access and interference management'（蜂窝与多址、频率复用/干扰）、'Capacity of wireless channels'、'Multiuser capacity…'、'MIMO I: spatial multiplexing and channel modeling'、'MIMO II…' —— 覆盖路径损耗、多径、分集、MIMO、多址接入与蜂窝；OFDM 没有独立章节（只在 MIMO 建模处涉及），4G/5G 物理层现状（书成于 2005 年）未覆盖
resource.publisher: David Tse（Stanford）与 Pramod Viswanath 的作者主页，Cambridge University Press 出版

courses.prereq_text: Recommended Prerequisite: Should have completed the following course(s): EE 279 Introduction to Digital Communication 3 Units. EE 279 or instructor consent recommended.
courses.scope_text: This course will cover advanced topics in wireless communications as well as current wireless system design. Topics include: an overview of current and future wireless systems; wireless channel models including path loss, shadowing, and statistical multipath channel models; fundamental capacity limits of wireless channels; digital modulation and its performance in fading and under intersymbol interference; techniques to combat fading including adaptive modulation and diversity; multiple antenna (MIMO) techniques to increase capacity and diversity, intersymbol interference including equalization, multicarrier modulation (OFDM), and spread spectrum; and multiuser system design, including multiple access techniques.
courses.hours_text: Units: 3–4（页面：'Course is 3 units but can be taken for 4 units with an optional term project.'）

courses.course: 6.452 Principles of Wireless Communications（OCW Spring 2006，Prof. Lizhong Zheng）
courses.prereq_text: The prerequisite is 6.450, or permission of the instructors. We rely on 6.450 to build the connection between a real-life communication channel and its digitized models… We also require fluency in the main structures and concepts of digital communication systems, as well as the associated probabilistic analysis. We expect students to have some experience in linear algebra and probability.
courses.scope_text: This is a graduate-level introduction to the fundamentals of digital wireless communications. Our focus is on the design, the analysis, and the fundamental limits of wireless transmission systems…；指定教材为 Tse & Viswanath《Fundamentals of Wireless Communication》，Readings 页原文 'Required Textbook: Tse, David, and Pramod Viswanath. Fundamentals of Wireless Communication.'（该书章节：The wireless channel；Point-to-point communication: detection, diversity and channel uncertainty；Cellular systems: multiple access and interference management；Capacity of wireless channels；Multiuser capacity and opportunistic communication；MIMO I: spatial multiplexing and channel modeling…）
courses.hours_text: Course Meeting Times: Lectures: 2 sessions / week, 1.5 hours / session（OCW 未给学分数）

courses.school: 北京交通大学（中国大学MOOC）
courses.prereq_text: 预备知识：'“数字信号处理”课程相关知识点，如傅里叶变换、冲激响应、滤波器等；“通信原理”课程相关知识点，如调制技术、采样定理等；“信息论”课程相关知识点…'；常见问题：'《通信原理》是一门非常重要的专业基础课程，是《无线通信基础》的重要先修课程之一。'
courses.scope_text: 授课目标：'…能够理解无线通信的基本概念（如衰落、噪声、信道容量等），掌握无线通信的基础理论（调制解调理论、信道编码理论、检测理论）、关键技术（如均衡技术、分集技术、交织技术等）和重要算法…特别是当前4G和5G中的核心技术（如正交频分复用和多天线技术）'；常见问题：'《无线通信基础》针对无线通信，特别是蜂窝移动通信系统（包括3G、4G和5G），分析无线电波传播和无线信道的特性…以及3G系统的码分多址（CDMA），4G和5G系统采用的正交频分复用（OFDM）和多天线（MIMO）等核心技术。'

notes: 候选判断：E.2.3 由三门课共同支持——Stanford EE 359 把 EE 279（数字通信）列为 recommended；MIT 6.452 把 6.450（数字通信 I）列为 required；北交大把《通信原理》称为'重要先修课程之一'。E.2.1（数字信号处理）只有北交大一门明确写（'数字信号处理课程相关知识点'）。M.3.1 只有 MIT 6.452 的 'We expect students to have some experience in linear algebra'（写作 expect，按 recommended 记）。C.3.3（无线、移动与物联网网络，含网络层与设备网络）三门课都没提：EE 359 与 6.452 只讲物理层/链路层，北交大的多址接入属物理层，不是 C.3.3 的网络层内容。另核对到：MIT 6.7440 Principles of Wireless Communication（https://catalog.mit.edu/subjects/6/ 原文 'Prereq: 6.7410'，即要求数字通信课，与 E.2.3 一致）；MIT OCW 6.452 的 Readings 页确认其指定教材就是 Tse & Viswanath，故英文主入口取该书作者主页的免费 PDF（OCW 6.452 页面只有 syllabus/readings/assignments/projects，没有讲义或视频）。
